node: HVDC, FACTS, high-voltage reactors, harmonic filters, STATCOM systems, instrument transformers, and grid power-quality equipment
summary: Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the HVDC/FACTS and high-voltage power-quality node. The best direct US-listed underfollowed fit found in this pass is AMSC, because its D-VAR product is explicitly a STATCOM/FACTS solution for voltage stability, renewable interconnection, and grid reliability. PLPC and POWL are second-order grid buildout suppliers: not pure HVDC/FACTS vendors, but they sit in constrained physical grid hardware and engineered electrical distribution systems where utility qualification, reliability, and project-cycle stickiness may matter. GEV is included only as a reference anchor because it is a direct HVDC/FACTS leader but is mega-cap and highly visible.
